paragraphs: The 440i was introduced as a replacement for the 435i during the F32/F33/F36 generation's lifecycle, arriving in 2016. It uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine that represented a clean-sheet design from BMW and became widely regarded as one of the brand's most robust modern six-cylinder units. The B58 was fitted to the 440i across the entire F32/F33/F36 range from 2016 until production ended in 2020. In the current G22/G23/G26 generation, the M440i xDrive carries the B58 forward, but the 440i name itself was discontinued at the end of the F-generation run — so any 440i on the road today is an F32, F33 or F36 model. The 440i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
